havainnekuva.prompt: Create one 16:9 landscape concept illustration for an educational world-map game's antique 'Atlas sheet' base-map lens. Show a large globe occupying the right two thirds of the frame, its surface visibly wrapped in a warm ivory nineteenth-century engraved atlas texture: fine copperplate coastlines, sepia relief hatching, restrained muted green and ochre land washes, elegant graticule, aged paper grain. A partly unfurled flat atlas sheet sits to the left and visually flows onto the globe to explain the idea of a historical paper map projected onto a sphere. Historically evocative of an 1875 Stieler atlas, but this is entirely newly imagined concept art: do not reproduce any specific Stieler plate, exact historical borders, readable place names, atlas title, labels, text, logos, watermark or UI. Geography should be broadly credible; polished restrained museum style, age 13+, soft studio daylight. The image must not imply it is an actual public-domain scan or a georeferenced game layer.

havainnekuva.prompt: Create one polished 16:9 landscape concept illustration for an educational game's natural satellite-surface globe lens. A single complete Earth globe dominates the frame against a subtle deep-space navy background, sunlit hemisphere centered on Africa, Europe and the Atlantic with recognizable geography, realistic blue oceans, clouds, coastlines, deserts and forests. A small circular magnification inset reveals natural-color terrain texture near a generic European coastline and connects gently to the globe, suggesting a seamless transition from global surface to a closer city region. Restrained science-museum visual direction, high clarity, suitable for ages 13+. This is generated concept art, not actual NASA Blue Marble or ESA Sentinel-2 data, not a georeferenced playable texture. No captions, text, labels, numbers, logos, flags, UI chrome or watermark; no fake data overlays.

havainnekuva.prompt: Create one 16:9 landscape concept illustration for an educational game's 'night lights' world-map base layer. Show a full round Earth globe from space on a dark indigo background, night hemisphere centered on Europe, Africa and western Asia; coastlines and cloud wisps remain geographically credible. Warm tiny city-light constellations concentrate broadly around populated regions and fade naturally over seas and deserts, with a soft atmospheric rim and a little dawn at the edge. No exaggerated solid glowing borders or fabricated exact light-intensity map. Polished and contemplative science-museum art, suitable for age 13+. This is generated concept art only, not NASA Black Marble observations or a georeferenced playable layer. No text, captions, dates, numbers, legends, color bar, logos, flags, watermark or UI chrome.
